message.content:
Painting the Eiffel Tower is a massive undertaking that depends on a handful of variables—crew size, equipment, weather, and the scope of the job (full repaint vs. touch‑ups). A rough ballpark estimate for a full repaint by a professional crew would be:

| Crew Size | Estimated Time |
|-----------|----------------|
| Small crew (≈ 10 workers) | ~ 14–21 days |
| Medium crew (≈ 30 workers) | ~ 7–10 days |
| Large crew (≈ 50+ workers) | ~ 3–5 days |

These figures assume continuous work under good weather conditions and that all necessary permits and safety measures are in place. In practice, the actual duration could be longer due to logistical constraints, inspections, and unforeseen delays.
